_comment:
'If you have a base legs equipped, transform it into this, then equip this.' + '**Battleworn**'. Mechanologist Action Equipment - Evo Base Legs (Bright Lights).

Battleworn is a printed keyword (printed_keywords) firing from the card DB keywords field - deliberately NOT authored.

The transform clause is the card's ONLY rules text and it is NOT AUTHORED - inexpressible today, so this file is a documented stub rather than a guess. The triage list said TRANSFORM + CONTROLS_SUBTYPE, but neither primitive survives contact with its handler: (a) the DSL TRANSFORM effect's _do_transform (effect_types.py:1048-1068) ALWAYS creates a NEW TOKEN named by 'to' and puts the sources under it - authoring to=evo_sentry_base_legs_red would mint a duplicate token copy of this card in the permanents zone, not equip the played card into the legs slot; (b) CONTROLS_SUBTYPE (condition_types.py:1849-1879) scans player.permanents.cards ONLY and can never see equipped equipment sitting in player.legs, so gating on it would be dead code. A separate gate is redundant anyway: the TRANSFORM handler's own all-or-nothing sources check (effect_types.py:3917-3936) already refuses when no matching card is equipped. Same finding as sibling drafts evo_charging_rods_yellow and evo_heartdrive_blue.

Release notes: this card HAS the base subtype and CAN be transformed into another evo. When the generic fix lands, OTHER evos' clause 1 must reach this card via sources [{"zone": "legs", "from": "Base"}] (the TRANSFORM matcher tests subtype membership, effect_types.py:3911-3915), and nothing here should strip Base.
generic_fix: Needs a generic effect that equips the source card into its slot zone while putting the displaced equipment underneath it (equip-with-subcards). Every Evo card in this batch shares the gap.
